_comment: Overlay patched onto schema/lab_journal_schema.json for the Chemotion ELN case. Not a standalone JSON Schema: 'required_add' appends to the base 'required'; 'procedure_step_types' restricts the allowed procedure step types. Everything under 'properties' is deep-merged onto the base. The Chemotion case keeps the base's relaxed journal_number and optional project_type, and allows the full step set (including Filter).

journal_number.description: Unique experiment identifier. For Chemotion ELN exports this is the reaction short label (Chemotion field 'short_label'), e.g. ZAR-439.
